calendar.final_refit: all resolved canonical rows; stored separately and forbidden from OOF metrics
calendar.inner_hpo: three chronological purged folds inside the April reference population; every train label resolution must be strictly before validation start

feature_selection.contract: full univariate plus Relief plus MDA pipeline independently by side and unique role target
feature_selection.cv_contract: strictly chronological and purged: validate on April only, train on resolved December-March rows only; classifier short-history fallback is chronological and shuffled fallback is forbidden; each regression selector fold requires at least 250 validation rows
feature_selection.event_role_reuse: the exact meaningful-MFE event selector is shared by peak, timing, and MAE because the event target is identical
feature_selection.reference_sample: up to 45000 resolved pre-May rows spread across December-April; April is the feature-selection validation tail

bars_before_price_stops_decreasing.deployment_rule: choose a side-local OOF winner only if aggregate and worst-month gates agree; otherwise diagnostic-only

future_slope_atr_per_hour.deployment_rule: diagnostic-only unless an identical-row May-July ablation adds aggregate and worst-month economic value beyond peak plus timing

time_to_first_meaningful_mfe.transform: hold the shared exact meaningful-event CDF_12h fixed; cap and PAV-project only CDF_2h/CDF_4h/CDF_8h so CDF_2h <= CDF_4h <= CDF_8h <= CDF_12h

hpo.cdf_parameter_sharing: one side-local classifier HPO study scored jointly across 2h, 4h, 8h, and 12h; fit four threshold models with the frozen winner
hpo.early_stop: stop after 12 completed or pruned trials without improvement, after at least 12 trials

sample_weights.default: unit weights for all direct roles
sample_weights.reason: preserve the declared probability and conditional-mean estimands; target-derived weights would change calibration or the estimand
sample_weights.weighted_variants: allowed only as a separately named OOF ablation and never as the default production contract

promotion_gates.adverse_variant: side-local aggregate and worst-month OOF winner; fail closed on mixed result
promotion_gates.candidate_identity: every emitted prediction is an exact canonical candidate and final-refit predictions are excluded
promotion_gates.economics: identical-row cost-aware aggregate and worst-month improvement before execution-EV consumption
promotion_gates.representation_availability: report every head by side and gmm_representation_available; no material missing-slice collapse
promotion_gates.slope: absent from deployable output until incremental-value gate passes

resource_contract.execution: one side, role, and fold at a time with checkpoints
